title: 被问资本是否更强：平安联席CEO，亮出偿付能力底牌
speaker: Michael Guo

segments.en: Well, is that an indication? I mean, you were not part of that capital injection, obviously.
segments.zh: 那么，这是一个信号吗？我的意思是，显然你们没有参与那次注资。

segments.en: But does that indicate that the authorities are pretty much, you know, confident that your capital position is much better than perhaps some of these big state insures?
segments.zh: 但这是否表明，当局相当有信心，认为你们的资本状况比一些大型国有保险公司要好得多？

segments.en: No, we have a very strong confidence on ourselves. And actually from a regulatory firing and from a regulatory perspective, our solvency ratio is well above the regulatory requirement. So moving forward, we actually don't see this a challenge.
segments.zh: 不，我们对自己非常有信心。实际上，从监管角度来看，我们的偿付能力充足率远高于监管要求。因此，未来我们并不认为这是一个挑战。

segments.en: We actually don't see a way of us being in a kind of weak position. We actually want to take advantage of this low-reinjustice environment,
segments.zh: 我们并不认为自己会处于弱势地位。实际上，我们希望利用当前低利率环境，

segments.en: making sure that we effectively lower our cost of reliability moving forward.
segments.zh: 确保我们有效降低未来的负债成本。
